body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 in our El Capitan Tier is designed to make extended travel feel comfortable, capable, and connected. Inside, it brings together warm finishes, smart storage, a full kitchen, indoor shower, climate control, and a queen bed for a true home-on-the-road feel. Outside, the upgraded suspension, all-terrain wheels, front bumper, winch, roof rack, lighting package, electric awning, and rear storage setup make it ready for bigger trips and remote destinations.
